The reference images match very well. The test image shows:
- Yellowing/chlorotic leaves with small scattered brown spots
- The lower leaf displaying significant interveinal yellowing with small angular brown lesions
- Pattern consistent with defoliation progressing from lower canopy upward

This matches perfectly with **Septoria_brown_spot**: angular red-to-brown spots on yellowing leaves, with premature yellowing and defoliation from lower leaves moving upward.
